BmsSnapshot.description: Body of the snapshot record captured by bms_snapshot_logger_tick. Almost every field is a copy of one word or byte of the BMS state block, at the state offset named in its description.

fields.name: state_words
fields.description: Thirteen 16-bit words copied in order from the state block at +0x140 to +0x158 (state + 0x140 + 2 * i). Meaning not visible in this packet.

fields.name: current
fields.description: 16-bit value copied from the state block at +0x11A (described as the current). Sign and units are not visible in the decompile.

fields.name: state_bytes
fields.description: Low bytes of the state words at +0x12C, +0x12E, +0x130, +0x134, +0x136 and +0x138. The word at +0x132 is skipped by the bit mask 0x77.

fields.name: byte_11e
fields.description: Byte at state +0x11E. Balancing and charge logic compare the state words at +0x104, +0x11E and +0x19C as levels, so this is probably a percentage-like level.

fields.name: byte_19c
fields.description: Byte at state +0x19C. Balancing logic treats the word at +0x19C as a threshold, so this is probably a percentage-like threshold.

fields.name: word_124
fields.description: 32-bit value built from the state words at +0x124 (low half) and +0x126 (high half).

fields.name: word_194
fields.description: 32-bit value built from the state words at +0x194 (low half) and +0x196 (high half).

fields.name: word_13c
fields.description: 16-bit state word at +0x13C, copied as is.

fields.name: word_13e
fields.description: 16-bit state word at +0x13E, copied as is.

fields.name: byte_180
fields.description: Byte at state +0x180. Meaning not visible in this packet.

fields.name: byte_1d2
fields.description: Byte at state +0x1D2. Meaning not visible in this packet.

ExtflashSlot.description: One slot record of the external-flash journal. Only the fields that bms_extflash_journal_init touches are named here; bytes 2 and 3 are not described.

fields.name: state
fields.description: Set to 1 for every slot by bms_extflash_journal_init. Probably a slot in-use or valid marker.

fields.name: flag
fields.description: Cleared to 0 by bms_extflash_journal_init. Meaning not visible in this packet.

fields.name: word_04
fields.description: Cleared to 0 at init. Meaning not visible in this packet.

fields.name: word_08
fields.description: Cleared to 0 at init. Meaning not visible in this packet.

fields.name: word_0c
fields.description: Cleared to 0 at init. Meaning not visible in this packet.

fields.name: word_10
fields.description: Cleared to 0 at init. Meaning not visible in this packet.

SampleWindowBlock.description: Six-word result block returned by bms_sample_window_process. The writers are bms_sample_window_process itself and bms_record_set_or_clear, which presets the words from its arguments.

fields.name: value_lo
fields.description: Low half of the first word: the result of bms_4168_0800379c applied to the measurement record.

fields.name: value_hi
fields.description: High half of the first word: the record's 16-bit value at +0x10 times a per-mille derate factor (1000 below 20, falling with the value at +6), divided by 1000.

fields.name: edge_count
fields.description: Low half of the second word: counter of rising edges of the record byte at +3 (tracked in DAT_20000602). bms_record_set_or_clear presets it from param_4.

fields.name: accum
fields.description: Third word: running value returned by bms_4168_08003868 on each call. bms_record_set_or_clear presets it from param_3.

fields.name: derived
fields.description: Fourth word: the accumulator times a percentage of the record's +0x12 value, divided by 1000. Probably a scaled quantity.

fields.name: window_wide
fields.description: Fifth word: state of the wide window latch, kept by bms_window_latch_wide. bms_record_set_or_clear presets it from param_1.

fields.name: window_narrow
fields.description: Sixth word: state of the narrow window latch, kept by bms_window_latch_narrow. bms_record_set_or_clear presets it from param_2.

RxQueueSlot.description: One record of the 256-slot receive queue. Field order follows bms_record_queue_pop, which reads the six words, clears them and builds an output record with the identifier at +0, the flags at +4 and +5, the length at +6 and up to 8 payload bytes at +7.

fields.name: dlc
fields.description: Field 0: data length of the queued frame. The pop uses its low byte as the output length and as the number of payload bytes copied.

fields.name: flag_a
fields.description: Field 1: flag that the pop stores as a bool at output +4. Its meaning is not visible in this packet.

fields.name: flag_b
fields.description: Field 2: second flag that the pop stores as a bool at output +5. Its meaning is not visible in this packet.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Field 3: identifier, copied to the output record at +0.

fields.name: data_0
fields.description: Field 4: first four payload bytes, probably. Copied with data_1 to the output record at +7.

fields.name: data_1
fields.description: Field 5: payload bytes 4 to 7, probably. Copied with data_0 to the output record at +7.
